_meta.description: Source of truth for Projects (ADR 0010): human-confirmed groupings of many topics into one followable real-world thing (a place, program, event or works). Keyed by SUBJECT, not topic id, so they survive re-import slug churn — the same protection human-relations.json gives the saved links. Re-materialise into the D1 tables projects + project_topics with: node db/apply-projects.js --apply
_meta.id_rule: Every project id is a HUMAN-CHOSEN slug — a person writes it, it is never derived from AI-extracted text, and no code mints one. Once chosen it never changes.

_meta.created_on: 2026-07-12 — session 26, issue #92 (storage only). Empty by design: seeding the first real Projects (the pool, the GreenWay, the Parramatta Rd corridor) is issue #93's job, where each membership is confirmed against the infocouncil source documents, never against stored headlines.
_meta.seeded_on: 2026-07-19 — session 28, issue #93. First four Projects confirmed by Lee. Membership was confirmed against topic subjects and meeting dates in D1, NOT yet re-checked against the infocouncil source PDFs — every one of these 25 memberships is self-evident from a named facility, corridor or plan in the subject line, so the risk is low, but a source-document pass is still owed before these drive a public page. Three scope calls Lee made explicitly: Leichhardt Park Wharf and Pontoon is OUT of the pool (same park, different facility); Greenway Art Prize and Gadigal Greenway lighting are OUT of the GreenWay (branded-after, and a different corridor); Parramatta Rd stays SEPARATE from Our Fairer Future rather than merging into one housing Project.
